(Ongoing sk_act_1) has no licensed marker — a participial reduced relative ('police acting on a tip-off') is none of the exactly four markers the instruction set allows for Ongoing.

notes: 'Atlanta, Georgia' is handled exactly as the stacked-place rule specifies — (Location sk_arrest_1 atlanta) plus (LocatedIn atlanta georgia), with no LocatedIn on the person — and the by-phrase Agent, the 'act on' preposition-named oblique and the Weekday-plus-day-part time atoms are all right.
